mapper.select: SELECT equipment_id, equipment_name, line_no, zone, manufacturer, cycle_time, health_score, remaining_life, replacement_date, expected_lifetime_hours, accumulated_run_hours FROM equipment ORDER BY equipment_id

SELECT equipment_id, equipment_name, line_no, zone, manufacturer, cycle_time, health_score, remaining_life, replacement_date, expected_lifetime_hours, accumulated_run_hours FROM equipment WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment (equipment_id, equipment_name, line_no, zone, manufacturer, cycle_time, health_score, remaining_life, replacement_date) VALUES (#{equipmentId}, #{equipmentName}, #{lineNo}, #{zone}, #{manufacturer}, #{cycleTime}, #{healthScore}, #{remainingLife}, #{replacementDate})
